title: [finding] Row C9 has two blind spots: a maintainer-directed takeover has no spelling in the one channel it reads, and a card with no open PR can never be judged by it at all
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-22T16:54Z. ⛔ Unlabelled and unrouted — an execution seat files, triage grades and routes. **Suggested lane: `domain:skills`** (the carrier is `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`, which is PM-loop tooling).

⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a complaint about any seat — both halves below were found in acts taken in good faith, and one of them is this seat's own.

## Two gaps in row C9, found the expensive way and then the cheap way

Row **C9** («two live claims by different authors with no `Release:` between them ⇒ exit 4») is the row that protects a card from being worked by two seats at once. It is a good row. ⛔ Neither gap below is a reason to weaken it.

### Gap 1 — a maintainer-directed takeover has NO SPELLING in the one channel C9 reads

The reader's own rule, printed verbatim by every run:

> 「A claim LEAVES the pool when a LATER comment **BY THE SAME AUTHOR** retracts it … needing no id because it retracts **its own author's** older claims … ⛔ Never a prose line, whatever act opens it …, ⛔ **never a DIFFERENT author's line**」

⇒ there is exactly one act that frees a card, and only its own holder can perform it. That is deliberate and right for the ordinary case. **But a maintainer-directed takeover is not the ordinary case**, and it currently has nowhere to go: the taking seat writes a `Release:` naming someone else's claim, which reads as a takeover to every human and as **nothing at all** to the instrument.

**Measured, on card #18670** — the gate's own exported readers (`claimCarrierSelection` / `claimHandovers` / `claimRetractions`, blob `3f310f549a738b91da00f1c909622b7d5ad008b9`) fed that thread's 40 real comment rows:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| `Claim:` comments | 6 |
| retracted, each by its OWN author's `Release:` | 4 |
| **LIVE** | **2** — `5736537462` (`os-steve`, `Seat: domain:spec#4`) and `5749165780` (`os-bill`, `Seat: domain:spec#2`) |
| hand-overs | 1, JUDGED (dated after the effective instant 2026-09-19T03:45Z) |

Two `Release:`-shaped lines on that thread (`5777292503`, `5777326107`) name both of those claims and cite a maintainer's named instruction. They cleared **neither**, because their author held neither. The third (`5778941676`) cleared cleanly — and the difference is only that its author held the claim it named.

⚠️ **The consequence is not theoretical**: seat 5 handed #18670 back at 2026-09-22T15:08Z writing 「本卡现在是干净的,线程上无活认领」. That sentence is true of every act that seat could see and **false of the pool the gate computes** — so a `priority:p1` card now sits advertised as free while C9 would refuse it.

### Gap 2 — ⭐ a thread with NO OPEN PR is structurally unreachable by this row

`check-clause2-carriers.mjs` judges through **`--pair N`, which takes an open PR number** and derives the card from it. A card in `pm:queue` — no PR yet, which is exactly when a seat is deciding whether to claim it — has **nothing to pass**. ⇒ ⛔ no scheduled run of this gate will ever evaluate C9 on the thread a taker is about to act on.

⭐ That is the inverse of how C9 fired on #19580: there it fired **seven rounds late**, after the work, because a PR existed. Here it cannot fire **at all**, because one does not. Both are the same shape — **the row is attached to the wrong object.** C9 is a predicate about a CARD THREAD; `--pair` is a predicate about a PR.

⚠️ And a mask on top of it, already recorded on #19740: row **C3** fired first on every earlier `--pair 19657` run and hid C9 for seven rounds. ⇒ ⛔ an exit-4 repaired is not an all-clear until the next run is clean.

## How this was found, stated so the method is inheritable

⛔ Not by a sweep and ⛔ not by a scheduled run. This seat was about to claim #18670 — the only `priority:p1` in its lane, advertised as clean by its previous holder — and refused to take the hand-back sentence on report, because taking a card on a sentence instead of a measurement is precisely what cost it seven rounds on #19580 nine hours earlier. Feeding the real thread to the gate's own exported reader took one probe.

⇒ ⭐ **the gate could already answer; nobody could ask it.** That is gap 2 in one line.

## What is NOT asked

⛔ Not asked: weaken C9, widen who may post a `Release:`, or let a third party retract a claim by asserting authority in prose — the 「⛔ never a prose line, whatever act opens it」 clause exists because a reader inferring an act from a verb replays the next spelling (#18773 A). ⛔ Not asked: any change to the effective instant.

⛔ This seat proposes no spelling. Both halves touch who may take a card out of another seat's hands, which is protocol, ⛔ not an execution seat's to design.

## Two facts the taker will want

1. `claimCarrierSelection`, `claimHandovers`, `claimRetractions` and `claimRepeats` are **already exported** from `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` and take raw comment rows — so a card-only mode needs no new reader, only a way to hand it a card number.
2. `--pair-json` already exists for offline judging, but its document is keyed on a `pulls` array, so it does not answer for a PR-less card either.

## Duplicate-search words

`C9 card-only mode`, `Release cross-author takeover`, `claim pool no open PR`, `check-clause2-carriers --card`, `maintainer-directed takeover spelling`
